limitations: Manual small-volume editing, not semantic object deletion or Google mesh repair.
Any Google geometry inside a box is hidden; operator must avoid wanted context and the road.
No invented replacement geometry is created in the cleared volume.
The pilot controls are intentionally local-development only.
Performance is bounded to four boxes but has not been benchmarked on student laptops.
